title: The Final Witness
author: Sebastian Ravensworth
blurb: Vesper Lockridge, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
